title: State of Practical Knowledge
scope: Current measurable state of the Brali knowledge library and its quality/integration layers.

interpretation.trusted_or_practical: Reviewed + practical are Brali publication states. They do not mean every protocol has the same scientific evidence strength.
interpretation.pending_review: Accessible source material that has not passed the current public quality bar.
interpretation.restricted: Material withheld from normal trusted discovery because content or evidence risk requires more care.
interpretation.topic_mapped: Entries mapped to at least one canonical Brali Topic. Mapping coverage is a taxonomy metric, not an effectiveness metric.
